details.flavorMarkdown: *A mobile knot of woody roots and hooked vines, dense enough to resemble an ordinary bramble patch. Its outer stems drag prey toward the heavy root mass at its center.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Hooked vine

*A hooked limb braces against the bank and heaves its catch toward the dark water.*

**Target:** One creature within 3 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Pull 2. **Standard defense:** Pull 1.

### Root grip

*A coil or grasping limb closes around the target and braces against its struggling weight.*

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Grappled 2. **Standard defense:** Grappled 1.

**Limit:** The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Animal tracks vanish into brush that grows against the season.

**Purpose:** Keep warm bodies near its roots.

**Tactics and retreat:** Pull a target into difficult ground, then seize it on a later turn.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Clear a lane and use distance; do not wade into the entire patch.

**Habitat:** Forest; overgrown ruin · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** A trapped pack or a named seed sought by a gardener.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-thorn-lurker


**Category:** Plant · **Role:** Ambush controller · **CV:** 17

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hooked vine | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 4 physical damage. Pull 1. | 5 physical damage. Pull 2. |
| Root grip | Brawn | 1 Boon | 1 physical damage. | 2 physical damage. Grappled 1. | 3 physical damage. Grappled 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** A slow or broad exposed body gives the attacker a Boon. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 3/4/5

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.4

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.596, O=3.298. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [drag under](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/drag-under.md), [seizing limbs](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/seizing-limbs.md).
